display.intent: Create a pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} creates pool ${accounts.pool} at a spot price of ${data.args.spotPrice}, with an LP fee of ${data.args.lpFeeBp} and referral ${data.args.referral}

display.intent: Update a pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} sets pool ${accounts.pool} to a spot price of ${data.args.spotPrice}, with an LP fee of ${data.args.lpFeeBp} and referral ${data.args.referral}

display.intent: Set a pool's allowlists
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.cosigner} sets which NFTs pool ${accounts.pool} of ${accounts.owner} trades

display.intent: Close a pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} closes empty pool ${accounts.pool}

display.intent: Deposit SOL into a pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} deposits ${data.args.paymentAmount} into the buy side of pool ${accounts.pool}

display.intent: Withdraw SOL from a pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} withdraws up to ${data.args.paymentAmount} from the buy side of pool ${accounts.pool}

docs: When the pool draws on its owner's Magic Eden shared escrow, the first two are the Magic Eden (M2) program and that escrow, which pays for the NFT. Then the creators of the NFT, in the order of its metadata, who receive the royalty the pool pays.

display.intent: Sell an NFT to a pool
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} sells ${data.args.assetAmount} of NFT ${accounts.assetMint} to pool ${accounts.pool} and receives at least ${data.args.minPaymentAmount} after fees and royalties; the ${data.args.takerFeeBp} taker fee and the ${data.args.makerFeeBp} maker fee go to ${accounts.referral}

docs: The creators of the NFT, in the order of its metadata, who receive the royalty the buyer pays.
